name: Denmark Open
stakes: This week is a crucial opportunity for India's top shuttlers to gain vital ranking points and build momentum in the lead-up to major championships.
summary:
India's campaign at the Denmark Open has begun with mixed fortunes, highlighting the challenging nature of this Super 750 event. In men's singles, **Lakshya Sen** faced a formidable opponent right out of the gate, bowing out in the first round to Chinese Taipei's Chou Tien Chen. This early exit is a setback for Sen, who was undoubtedly looking to make a deeper run and gather crucial ranking points.

Meanwhile, all eyes are on **PV Sindhu** in the women's singles draw. She faces a tough opener against her formidable nemesis, An Se-young, a matchup that promises fireworks and will test Sindhu's current form and readiness. With the tournament just kicking off, India will be hoping for strong performances from its remaining contingent, including top-ranked men's doubles pair Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, to make a significant impact in Odense.
